Using the corrected identity,
\[
\sum_{i=1}^4 A_i h_i = 12V.
\]
Thus
\[
\mathbb E[k] = \frac{\sum A_i h_i}{S}
= \frac{12V}{S}.
\]
Since the inradius is \(r=3\),
\[
V = \frac13 rS = S,
\]
so
\[
\mathbb E[k] = \frac{12S}{S} = 12.
\]
This value is independent of the tetrahedron’s shape, so the minimum possible value is

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
